recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Station use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: At the top of the command center, select the settings button beside Auto Station.

items.label: Evacuate at
items.description: Start evacuation this many minutes before impact, or immediately when an attack is first detected inside that window.

items.label: Minimum Bird Days on Target
items.description: Choose an alliance destination with more than this many days of remaining protection; 0 removes the minimum.
items.recommendation: 3 days, so the destination must have more than 3 days remaining.

items.label: Recall when clear
items.description: Return stationed troops when the last detected attack has passed and no incoming attack remains.

items.label: Open Gate Fallback
items.description: When troops cannot evacuate, this opt-in opens six-hour gates at the attacked owned castle in any kingdom except Berimond.
items.recommendation: Off unless you want automatic gate opening when evacuation fails.

items.label: Purchased Protection Mode
items.description: When purchased Protection Mode is preparing or active, Auto Station uses gates even with the fallback off, except in Berimond.

image.alt: Fictional Auto Station settings with evacuation timing, protection days, recall, gate fallback and castle reserves
image.caption: Review the four response controls and each castle's defense reserves before saving.

steps.title: Choose troops to keep at each castle

items.label: Add troops
items.description: Choose troop types to keep at the selected castle; an empty reserve leaves all eligible non-tool troops available to evacuate.
items.recommendation: Keep the usual defensive garrison at home while allowing spare attacking troops to move.

items.label: Quantity
items.description: Set how many of each chosen troop stay at this castle; 0 keeps none of that type.
items.recommendation: Use the number this castle needs for its normal defense.

items.label: Edit defense troops
items.description: Open the troop picker again to change the reserve types or quantities for this castle.

items.label: Remove defense troop
items.description: Remove a reserve tile to stop keeping that troop type at this castle.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Save the timing, toggles and per-castle reserves before leaving settings.

items.label: Auto Station switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Station at the top of the command center after saving to watch for incoming player attacks.
items.recommendation: On for regular protection after reviewing your reserves.
